description: Where a page is in the documentation, and what is around it: the folder it is in, the pages next to it (for a property, the class's other properties) or the pages it contains. Without an id, the top of the contents.

id.description: A page id (from search, lookup_api or fetch), a folder id from an earlier contents call, or a page URL. Leave out for the top.

name: contents
title: Browse the contents
